# Vendored CIFAR ResNet

`resnet.py` is copied unchanged from
[megvii-research/mdistiller](https://github.com/megvii-research/mdistiller/blob/a08d46f10d6102bd6e3f258ca5ac880b020ea259/mdistiller/models/cifar/resnet.py),
commit `a08d46f10d6102bd6e3f258ca5ac880b020ea259`.
Upstream LICENSE and notices are preserved in `LICENSE`.
Only the official model implementation is imported; training infrastructure is local.
